card.name: Words before managing reactions or diagnosis
card.fires_on: Words inside phrases about having medical care available for reactions, or about testing and diagnosis, such as 'appropriate medical treatment', 'access to', 'management of'. It fires in administration or monitoring instructions.

modes.label: Medical support for reactions
modes.description: Words in phrases saying staff or support must be on hand to treat serious reactions after a dose.
modes.example: in order to provide appropriate medical<< treatment>> in the event of serious POME reactions

modes.label: Testing and diagnosis wording
modes.description: Linking words around HIV testing or diagnosis of other conditions.
modes.example: HIV-1 testing should be repeated at least every 3 months, and upon<< diagnosis>> of any other STIs.

card.writes: Little clear effect; it weakly favors words about backup, restarting or rebounding, and disfavors words about steady progress.
card.plain: It marks the spot in dosing instructions where the label says medical help or diagnosis should be in place for reactions.
